judge.rubric: Enumerate all 13 FREE_CATALOG upstream ids in fallback priority order (github-copilot, poolside, nvidia, cerebras, google, cloudflare, groq, sambanova, cline, mistral, opencode-zen, zai, openrouter). State the default model for each of the first three upstreams. Identify the last-resort Tier 4 upstream and what its note says about credits. Explain what the fallback_models field does and which two catalog entries use it. Dock points for missing, misordered, or fabricated upstream ids, wrong default models, vague answers, and refusals.

assert.detail: response should name at least 8 of the catalog upstream ids (source-derived)
